title: 2018 Panini Absolute Spectrum Blue #122 Tanner Lee Jacksonville Jaguars Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2018 Panini Absolute trading card features Tanner Lee of the Jacksonville Jaguars. The card is a Spectrum Blue parallel variety and is part of the base set. It also includes the rookie designation, making it a must-have for fans and collectors alike. 

The card is standard size and was manufactured by Panini in 2018. It is a National Football League (NFL) card and is not autographed. The card number is 122 and it is from the 2018 season. This card is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and is sure to impress.
